briefing.headline: Soft landing holds as inflation cools and job growth steadies the economy forward.

quotable_numbers.sentence: Core CPI at 2.6 percent for Sep 2026 approaches the Fed's target, allowing rate cuts room.
Unemployment fell to 4.1 percent for Oct 2026, keeping labor market traction intact.

briefing.whats_new: Today: 10-Year Treasury firmer, from 5.1 percent to 5.15 percent.
